column1: # r3-P20 disagreement model (prespec.md): logistic regression of between-model disagreement on transcript quality and unit features
column2: fitted on the seen rung-2 base; odds ratios per unit of each predictor (recording quality per between-creator SD; unit deviation per SD; log words per unit of log words; edge and format against their reference: middle of the recording
column3: solo format; format levels under 5 creators pooled as 'other formats').

column1: # Counterfactual (transcript quality): every recording's quality shifted by -0.8 between-creator SD (the hold-out's published SMD for recognizer confidence

column4: compared with the published R-hold value only in words.
